source_system.title: Hospital Systems
source_system.description: The UnIC catalog collects and documents available data from hospital information systems. These systems include medical, administrative, and logistical data.

warehouse.description: The UnIC warehouse consists of a curated set of variables from hospital systems. These variables are organized by domain and documented according to a standard nomenclature.
warehouse.short_description: List of tables and variables from the UnIC data warehouse.

research_project.title: Research Projects
research_project.description: The data dictionaries detailing the characteristics of the dataset variables are produced by UnIC for research projects conducted at the CHUSJ.
research_project.short_description: Detailed list of variables and tables from datasets produced by UnIC for research at CHUSJ.

eqp.title: EQP Projects
eqp.description: The data dictionaries detailing the characteristics of the dataset variables are produced by UnIC for quality improvement projects.
